group: Heavy Metal L-Gaim + Blue Comet SPT Layzner (incl. ACE-original enemies met in those stages)

entries.role: Protagonist. Heir of the Yaman clan's Kamon dynasty (true name Kamon Myroad), raised on Koam; leads the rebellion against Poseidal. Pilots the L-Gaim, later the L-Gaim Mk-II.
entries.personality: Calm, earnest and somewhat reserved, hard to read; indecisive at times but prone to sudden outbursts of anger, and reckless whenever his adopted sister Quwasan is involved. Grows into a capable leader.
entries.notes: Identical in every English source checked (SRW wiki, Wikipedia, Nagano Mecha wiki page title, official SRW 30/Y English, Akurasu ACE2 DB). Real name Kamon Myroad.

entries.ja: ギャブレット・ギャブレー
entries.role: Daba's rival. Ambitious country noble from Koam who joins the Poseidal military (under Chai Char, later one of the Thirteen); commands the Slender Skala, finally sides with Daba to rescue Quwasan. Pilots Ashura Temple, A-Taul, Bat-Shu in ACE2.
entries.personality: Pompous and vain but sincere, warm-hearted and quick to fall in love; naive and comically airheaded, a rival with a sense of honor.
entries.notes: CONTESTED family/given spellings. 'Gavlet Gablae' is used by the SRW wiki series page, both Wikipedia articles, official Bandai Namco English (SRW 30 and SRW Y) and Akurasu's ACE2 DB. Variants seen: 'Gablet Gablae', 'Gavlet Gavlae', 'Gablet Gaburay' (Nagano Mecha wiki episode page), 'Galvet Cablae'/'Gablae Gavlet' (SRW wiki typos). Short label: the Japanese short form ギャブレー is his family name, so 'Gablae'.

entries.ja: オルドナ・ポセイダル
entries.role: Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
entries.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.
entries.notes: Spelling: 'Oldna Poseidal' is the SRW wiki and Wikipedia form; official SRW 30 English and MAHQ use 'Posaydal' ('Emperor Oldna Posaydal'), Nagano Mecha wiki has 'Oldona Posaydal'. Kept 'Poseidal' per the wiki rule. GENDER CAVEAT: the throne Poseidal (Mian, voiced by Saeko Shimazu) is female; the real Poseidal Amandara (Ryuichi Horibe) is male and is the anime's Aug pilot. Both voice actors are credited in ACE2 (raido.moe staff list) and Akurasu lists the ACE2 Aug pilot as 'Oldna Posaydal', so check in-game which voice speaks under the label ポセイダル. If it is Amandara's voice, switch gender to male.

entries.role: Daughter of the noble Gaw house and a rising member of Poseidal's Thirteen; defects to Daba's rebels. Later captains the Whale and pilots the Novel D-Sserd.
entries.personality: Bold, headstrong and reckless yet emotionally fragile; competes with Amu for Daba; becomes calmer and more mature later in the series.
entries.notes: 'Gaw Ha Leccee' is consistent across SRW wiki, Wikipedia, official SRW 30/Y English and Akurasu. The Japanese ED credit sometimes reads レッシー. Avoid 'Lessy'/'Lecee' (typos on the SRW wiki page).

entries.role: Would-be stage actress turned bandit who leaves the Miyama Lilin gang to join Daba. Later captains the shuttle Turner and takes over the L-Gaim when Daba gets the Mk-II.
entries.personality: Devoted to Daba and determined to be useful; not very talented at first but works hard; jealous, constantly squabbling with Leccee.
entries.notes: CONTESTED. 'Fanneria Amu' is used by the SRW wiki series page (cast table) and the Wikipedia main article; chosen under the wiki rule. Official Bandai Namco English (SRW 30, SRW Y) uses 'Fannaria Amm'; the Wikipedia character list heading is 'Fanaria Amm'; the SRW wiki gallery also has 'Amu Fannellia'. If you would rather follow the official game localization, use 'Fannaria Amm' / short 'Amm'.

entries.role: Daba's childhood friend and travelling companion; the group's mechanic (rebuilt the stolen AD Stack into the L-Gaim Mk-II with Mesh Maker) and an occasional D-Sserd pilot.
entries.personality: Goofy, girl-crazy, carefree joker; a big eater who is surprisingly strong; loyal friend and a skilled mechanic.
entries.notes: CONTESTED given name (ミラウー). 'Mirao Kyao' is the SRW wiki series-page and Wikipedia main-article form (chosen under the wiki rule). Official SRW 30 English and the Wikipedia character-list heading use 'Mirawoo Kyao'; 'Mirau Kyao' also occurs; the SRW wiki uses Japanese order 'Kyao Mirao' in places. Only the short 'Kyao' is safe; if you prefer the official game localization, use 'Mirawoo Kyao'.

entries.role: Seat no. 3 and de facto leader of Poseidal's Thirteen, the highest-ranking officer after Poseidal; rebels against Poseidal with his own fleet (the Giwaza fleet) and is killed in the final battle.
entries.personality: Capable, cold, calculating and ambitious; uses and discards people, including his lover Nei Mo Han; a political schemer.
entries.notes: 'Giwaza Lowau' is used by the SRW wiki series page and both Wikipedia articles. A literal romanization gives 'Giwaza Rowau'. No official SRW 30/Y English pilot entry was found (he appears only as 'Sarge Aupus (Giwaza)', his flagship).

entries.role: Daba's adopted younger sister and fiancee. Kidnapped and brainwashed by Poseidal via bio-relation; reappears as commander of Poseidal's Imperial Guard. Pilots a copper-yellow Calvary Temple.
entries.personality: Under mind control she is cold and obedient, acting on Poseidal's orders; underneath she is fragile, and her mind breaks down by the end of the series.
entries.notes: 'Quwasan Olibee' is used by the SRW wiki, Wikipedia and official SRW 30/Y English. Variants: 'Quwassan', 'Kuwasan', 'Quwasan Oribee'. The in-game short label クワサン is her given name, so 'Quwasan'.

entries.role: Generic speaker label for a rank-and-file soldier of the Poseidal Army.
entries.notes: Follows the 'Poseidal Army' faction spelling. Official SRW 30 style would give 'Posaydal Soldier'.

entries.role: Generic speaker label for a Poseidal Army officer.
entries.notes: Same faction-name convention as 'Poseidal Soldier'.

entries.role: Joint speaker label for Daba and Gavlet speaking together (e.g. during a combination attack or a shared line).
entries.notes: Built from the short forms 'Daba' and 'Gablae'. Akurasu lists L-Gaim Mk-II + Bat-Shu/Ashura Temple combination attacks in ACE2.

entries.role: Generic speaker label for a soldier of the anti-Poseidal rebel army (Daba's side).
entries.notes: English sources call Daba's side 'the rebels' / 'the rebellion' / 'rebel army' (Japanese 反乱軍).

entries.role: Protagonist. Half-Gradosian, half-human son of astronaut Ken Asuka; deserts Grados with the SPT Layzner to warn Earth of the invasion and then fights the Grados occupation.
entries.personality: A gentle pacifist who hates killing, torn between protecting Earth and fighting his own people; becomes a tougher, determined resistance fighter in the second arc.
entries.notes: Consistent in every source. Full name Albatro Nal (Null) Eiji Asuka, see the separate entry.

entries.ja: アルバトロ・ナル・エイジ・アスカ
entries.role: Full Gradosian name of Eiji Asuka (Albatro Null is his Grados name, Eiji his human name).
entries.notes: English Wikipedia and the SRW wiki write 'Albatro Null Eiji Asuka' / 'Eiji Asuka/Albatro Null'. The literal reading of ナル is 'Nal', and his sister's matching name element ミル is 'Mill'. Kept 'Null' as the wiki form.

entries.role: Grados lieutenant sent after Eiji (pilots the Bullgrenn). Rebuilt as a cyborg after his apparent death, he joins Le Cain's 'Shikitai' (Death Demon Squad) and pilots the MF Daljuan.
entries.personality: Sly, cruel sadist who enjoys killing; kills his own subordinates and frames others; vengeful and obsessive.
entries.notes: 'Gosterro' is used by the SRW wiki, Wikipedia and Akurasu's ACE2 DB. MAHQ uses 'Gostello' (a literal reading of ゴステロ; avoid it).

entries.role: Son of Admiral Gresco; supreme commander of the Grados Earth occupation forces in the second arc; Eiji's rival and the main villain. Pilots the SPT Zakaal.
entries.personality: Arrogant and ruthless, convinced of Gradosian racial and cultural superiority, yet proud and aristocratic. Despises dirty tactics and refuses to fight unfairly.
entries.notes: CONTESTED. 'Le Cain' is used by officially licensed English merchandise (Good Smile/Max Factory PLAMAX 'Layzner & Zakaal'), MAHQ and Akurasu's ACE2 DB. The SRW fandom wiki character list uses 'Ru Kain'; English Wikipedia uses 'Le Caine'. Japanese ル･カイン in the game uses a half-width middle dot.

entries.role: Daba's white A-class Heavy Metal, a Yaman-built mecha. Later piloted by Amu.
entries.notes: Universal spelling.

entries.role: Daba's second Heavy Metal, a transformable unit rebuilt from the Amon Duule Stack and armed with the Buster Launcher.
entries.notes: 'L-Gaim Mk-II' is used by Wikipedia, the SRW wiki and Akurasu's ACE2 DB, and matches the Japanese Mk-II. Official SRW 30/Y English writes 'L-Gaim Mark II'; MAHQ writes 'L-Gaim Mark-II'.

entries.ja: ヌーベル・ディザード
entries.role: Transformable A-class Heavy Metal (also called K Temple) lent by Amandara to Leccee after she rejoins the rebels.
entries.notes: Official SRW 30/Y English is 'Novel D-Sserd'; MAHQ and Akurasu ACE2 write 'Novel D.Sserd'. Japanese Wikipedia glosses it as 'Nouvelle D-Seerd' (nouvelle is French for 'new'); the SRW wiki has 'Novel D'ssart' and a 'D-Seerd'/'D-Sserd' page for the base unit. 'Nouvel Disard' is a non-standard rendering.

entries.role: Poseidal Army A-class Heavy Metal (one of a dozen replicas of a lost original); piloted by Gavlet Gablae and Heckler Mauser, and by Gavlet in the finale.
entries.notes: SRW wiki page title, official SRW 30/Y English, MAHQ and Akurasu all agree on 'Bat-Shu'. It evolved into 'Bashe the Black Knight' in Five Star Stories; do not use that here. (Akurasu's ACE2 DB has a stray 'Black Knight' pilot entry.)

entries.role: Poseidal Army Temple-series A-class Heavy Metal with four Power Launchers; piloted by Gavlet Gablae (his ACE2 unit) and Barn Gania Killas.
entries.notes: Universal spelling (name taken from the band Ash Ra Tempel).

entries.ja: カルバリー・テンプル
entries.role: Poseidal Army Temple-series A-class Heavy Metal with a chest laser reflector; Quwasan Olibee's unit (copper-yellow), also used by Hassha Mossha and others.
entries.notes: Official SRW 30/Y English and MAHQ agree. Not 'Cavalry'.

entries.role: Poseidal Army A-class Heavy Metal (replica of a Poseidal-family unit); main pilot Nei Mo Han.
entries.notes: Do not confuse it with オージ (Aug). Official SRW 30/Y English pairs オージェ = 'Auge' and オージ = 'Aug'.

entries.role: The true Poseidal's personal Heavy Metal (the 'Original Auge'), built from Auge/Blood Temple/Pudding Auge parts. In ACE2 it is piloted by Poseidal.
entries.notes: Official SRW 30/Y English, MAHQ and Akurasu ACE2 all use 'Aug'. Japanese Wikipedia glosses it as 'Aug/Original Auge'; the SRW wiki writes 'Original Auge (Or Aug)'.

entries.role: Mass-produced Poseidal Army A-class Heavy Metal armed with a remote-operated long spear; pilots include Nei Mo Han (ep. 31) and Lily Hasshi.
entries.notes: L-Gaim unit, not Layzner. Official SRW 30/Y English and MAHQ: 'G.Roon' (Japanese Wikipedia also glosses 'G.Roon'). It contains a period; if your font or label system cannot handle one, 'G-Roon' is an acceptable fallback, but keep 'G.Roon'.

entries.role: High-output Poseidal Army A-class Heavy Metal capable of solo flight; one of Gavlet Gablae's units (playable for him in ACE2).
entries.notes: The Nagano Mecha wiki page title is 'A-Taul' (matching official SRW 30/Y 'A-Taul V'). MAHQ, Akurasu ACE2 and Japanese Wikipedia write 'A.Taul'. 'Atoll' is a literal reading (the name comes from the French band Atoll), but no English source uses it.

entries.role: Custom A-Taul ('A-Taul Five', McTomin Build) of Thirteen member Maph McTomin, fitted with replica armaments from Auge, Bat-Shu, Ashura Temple and G.Roon.
entries.notes: Official SRW 30/Y English: 'A-Taul V'; MAHQ: 'A.Taul V'. The Roman numeral is rendered as ASCII V.

entries.role: SPT-LZ-00X, Eiji's experimental Grados SPT with the AI 'Rei' and the V-MAX system.
entries.notes: Official Sunrise site: LAYZNER. Universal spelling.

entries.role: E-MF-LZ-00X-2, the Earth-built successor design for Eiji that went unused in the TV series (the show was cut short); playable for Eiji in ACE2, including a 'Concept Ver.'
entries.notes: Akurasu ACE2 DB and MAHQ use 'Layzner Mk-II'; the SRW wiki uses 'Layzner Mark II'. It is NOT the Zakaal: the request's 'レイズナーMk-II (ザカール)' pairing is probably a combination-attack or lock-on grouping (Akurasu lists Layzner/Enhanced Layzner/Layzner Mk-II + Zakaal combos). Zakaal has its own entry.

entries.role: SPT-ZK-53U, Le Cain's gold custom SPT, the strongest Grados SPT, with a sealed V-MAX.
entries.notes: Official Sunrise site 'ZAKAAL', official Good Smile English, MAHQ and Akurasu all use 'Zakaal'. The SRW wiki and Wikipedia use 'Zakarl'.

entries.role: SPT-BG-91U, Grados commander-type SPT; Gosterro's unit in the first arc (playable for him in ACE2).
entries.notes: Official Sunrise 'BULLGRENN'; the same in the SRW wiki, Wikipedia, MAHQ and Akurasu. The request's 'ブルグレン?' is confirmed as a Layzner unit.

entries.role: MF-DJ-91U, Gosterro's custom Multi-Form unit as a Shikitai (Death Demon Squad) member, armed with a laser buzzsaw and a Broken Nail shield.
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Official Sunrise site and the MAHQ page title: 'DALJUAN'/'Daljuan'. The SRW wiki mecha list and Akurasu ACE2 DB: 'Daljan'. Chose the official/mecha-wiki form; use 'Daljan' if you prefer the SRW-wiki spelling.

entries.role: SPT-DM-20C, high-mobility mass-production Grados SPT (Karla Egiel's unit; widely used during the Earth occupation). Enemy unit.
entries.notes: Layzner unit (Grados), not L-Gaim. Official Sunrise 'DIMARGE'; MAHQ and the SRW wiki agree.

entries.role: SPT-GK-10U, Grados senior-officer SPT; Ahmos Gale's personal unit, specialized for space combat. Enemy unit.
entries.notes: Identified as a LAYZNER unit (Grados), not an ACE original. Official Sunrise site 'GRIMEKAISAR' and MAHQ 'Grimekaisar' (chosen). The SRW wiki and Wikipedia use 'Greimkaiser'. Related: ブラッディカイザル = Bloodykaisar (Julia's unit).

entries.role: MF-SL-52C, Grados mass-production Multi-Form unit for atmospheric use that transforms between aircraft and humanoid modes. Common enemy grunt of the Gresco fleet.
entries.notes: Identified as a LAYZNER unit (Grados), not an ACE original. Official Sunrise 'SOLOMCO' and MAHQ 'Solomco'; the SRW wiki has 'Slomco'.

entries.role: TS-SG-50C, Grados unmanned Terror Striker drone. Enemy unit.
entries.notes: Layzner unit (Grados). Variants: official Sunrise site 'SKALLGUNNER', MAHQ 'Skull Gunner' (chosen for readability; MAHQ page title), SRW wiki 'Skullgunner'.

entries.ja: ターミネーターポリス
entries.role: TS-TP-50D, unmanned Grados Terror Striker developed from the Skull Gunner and used to hunt Earth's resistance; capable of acrobatic maneuvers. Enemy unit.
entries.notes: Layzner unit (Grados). Official Sunrise 'TERMINATOR POLICE'; MAHQ and the SRW wiki agree. ポリス = 'Police', not 'Polis'.

entries.role: ACE original enemy (Banpresto design): upgraded infantry unit derived from the Risnir, with a left-arm gatling gun and twin right-arm beam cannons; also a squad-leader unit. Debuted in ACE1, returns in ACE2.
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. Japanese Wikipedia gives the Latin form 'Gnost' (from Tanngnjostr, Thor's goat). No English game localization exists.

entries.role: ACE original enemy (Banpresto design): air-combat fire-support unit resembling an Apache helicopter crossed with a robot (missiles, beam cannon, gatling). Debuted in ACE1, returns in ACE2.
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. Japanese Wikipedia gives the Latin form 'Thiassi' (the Norse frost giant Thiazi/Thjazi).

entries.role: ACE2 original enemy (FromSoftware design), one of the 'Rainen series' of autonomous units developed by the scientist Albert Rainen (アルバート・ライネン).
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. No Latin spelling found anywhere; 'Zarom' is a plain romanization ('Zalom' is equally possible). 'Rainen' is also a romanization guess for ライネン. Check whether the ACE2 game files or other glossary files give a Latin form.

entries.role: ACE2 original enemy (FromSoftware design): upgraded Zarom (Rainen series) with an added defensive field.
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. Follows the Zarom spelling; the full-width Ｄ is rendered as ASCII 'D'.

entries.role: ACE original enemy (FromSoftware design): heavy-artillery unit whose entire right arm is a large cannon; low mobility. A UCE prototype in ACE1, a Rainen-series unit in ACE2.
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. No official Latin form found. The ACE1/2 FromSoftware units are named after the German zodiac (Krebs = Cancer, Loewe = Leo, Waage = Libra, plus Shootia), so this is German 'Loewe' (lion), with 'oe' as the ASCII form of the o-umlaut. Alternatives: 'Lowe', 'Leve'.

entries.role: ACE original enemy (FromSoftware design): flight-capable unit specializing in mobile bombardment. A UCE prototype in ACE1, a Rainen-series unit in ACE2.
entries.notes: NOT L-Gaim or Layzner: this is an Another Century's Episode original enemy (Japanese Wikipedia 'オリジナル敵機' section). It presumably appears in the L-Gaim/Layzner stages as filler enemies. No official Latin form found; inferred as German 'Waage' (scales, i.e. Libra), matching the zodiac naming of Krebs and Loewe. Alternative: 'Vage'.

entries.role: The military of Emperor Poseidal that rules the Pentagona World; the main antagonist force of L-Gaim.
entries.notes: The SRW wiki (Bat-Shu page) uses 'Poseidal Army'; Wikipedia and MAHQ use 'Poseidal Military'; official SRW 30 English uses 'Posaydal Forces'. Pick one and stay consistent with the 'Poseidal' spelling.

entries.role: The Pentagona System / Pentagona World: the five-planet star system where L-Gaim is set (Koam, Mizum, Gastogal, Trydetol, ...).
entries.notes: Universal spelling. Use 'Pentagona World' or 'Pentagona System' where the context needs a noun.

entries.role: Giwaza Lowau's rebel fleet (mostly Sarge Opus planet cruisers of the Thirteen) that turns against Poseidal.
entries.notes: Descriptive translation; no fixed English title was found. 'Giwaza's Fleet' is also fine. His flagship is 'Sarge Opus' (MAHQ) / 'Sarge Aupus' (official SRW 30/Y).

entries.role: Generic class name for the humanoid mecha of L-Gaim (abbr. HM).
entries.notes: Universal. Abbreviation 'HM'.

entries.role: The alien Grados Empire, from the Udoria system, that invades and occupies Earth in Layzner. Adjective form: Gradosian.
entries.notes: Universal. Adjective 'Gradosian'.

entries.role: The Grados military forces conquering and occupying Earth (Admiral Gresco's, later Le Cain's, command).
entries.notes: No fixed English title was found. 制圧 = subjugation/suppression; the official Japanese site uses グラドス地球占領軍 ('Earth Occupation Army'). Alternatives: 'Grados Earth Occupation Force', 'Grados Earth Conquest Force'.

entries.role: Super Powered Tracer, the humanoid combat mecha of Layzner. Related classes: MF (Multi-Form) and TS (Terror Striker).
entries.notes: Keep as 'SPT'; expand to 'Super Powered Tracer' only where explanation is needed.

entries.role: The Layzner's (and Zakaal's) overdrive system: wraps the unit in a blue magnetic field for a high-speed charge that is impervious to lasers ('Blue Comet').
entries.notes: Universal. The stronger form is 'V-MAXIMUM' (ACE/SRW attack name).
